title: Kubernetes Networking Deep Dive
transcript: In this session we explore Kubernetes networking including pod to pod communication service discovery DNS resolution and network policies that govern traffic between namespaces and pods in a cluster environment.
notes: Key topics: pod networking, CNI plugins, service mesh, ingress controllers.

workflows.name: Set up a NetworkPolicy
steps: Create a NetworkPolicy manifest targeting your pod selector
Define ingress rules to allow traffic from permitted namespaces
